title: Missing moeb tool: read-absolute-path for tool result files
description: The native Claude Code Read tool was used to read the start_spec output file at an absolute path (C:\Users\Simeon\...\mcp-moeb-start_spec-*.txt) outside the working directory. mcp__moeb__read_file only accepts working-directory-relative paths, so there was no moeb equivalent. No MissingMoebTool signal was buffered at the time of the external tool call, violating moeb-tool-origin policy.
proposed_resolution: Run moeb spec to introduce a moeb equivalent covering large tool-result retrieval. Either (a) provide a streaming or chunked tool-result mechanism so MCP tools returning large outputs do not require an external file read, or (b) add a moeb read_tool_result tool that accepts a tool-result identifier and returns the content incrementally.
